notes: All 20 unique APIs from the input list were missing; the input list contained two duplicates (SetSecurityDescriptorDacl and ConvertToAutoInheritSecurityObject each listed twice).

None of the listed APIs existed in advapi32.c. The only pre-existing security-related functions were SetEntriesInAclA, GetSecurityInfo, and SetSecurityInfo (all stubs), which are NOT part of the checked list.

Each added function uses __attribute__((dllexport)), validates inputs, sets the last error via SetLastError/GetLastError (new module-level mechanism), and returns honest codes: ERROR_INVALID_SECURITY_DESCR=1336, ERROR_INVALID_ACL=1332, ERROR_INVALID_SID=1337, ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED=50, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED=5, ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER=87.
GetAclInformation, SetAclInformation, and ConvertToAutoInheritSecurityObject return ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED because SentinelOS has no ACL internals/auto-inherit subsystem to back them.

Supporting types/constants added: SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR, ACL, SID, ACL_SIZE_INFORMATION, SID_IDENTIFIER_AUTHORITY, SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR_CONTROL, revision and SE_* control flags, ERROR_INVALID_SECURITY_DESCR/ERROR_INVALID_ACL/ERROR_INVALID_SID, plus a helper sec_desc_valid().
Verified with clang -fsyntax-only: file compiles cleanly with no errors.
